algorithm: At every read boundary, find the entry by exact canonical program-pointer identity (including genuine owner interior addend).

For a record read, reject index<0 or index>=proven_bytes/stride. Use actual stride2/4/6 and ensure the entire requested record lies in the prefix. For separate WORD operands, check the incremented WORD index independently.
For direct selector pointer walking, maintain/check the WORD index before every dereference, including -40/-41 operands and following sprite reads.
For frame-table slot reads, reject negative/out-of-range indices; on a null, independently validate the following index WORD slot before loading it.

For auxiliary callback tables, check signed index against the logical view slot count and then reject null before indirect call; preserve the actual actor-pointer or low-byte-integer argument. Field030 has no identified internal dereferencing consumer.

Failure must invoke the existing centralized incomplete service with original program/table RVA and attempted index before any dereference. Do not fabricate an opcode sentinel, silently reset, dispatch the PC binary, or continue after failure.
Unknown pointer identities retain the established runtime policy. This recipe does not assert their capacity or permit guessed ranges.
validation_recipe: Exercise the last valid record/WORD for every registered pointer and its genuine owner addend.
Exercise index-1 and the first index beyond each recorded prefix; verify centralized failure happens before a load or side effect.
Exercise a WORD operand increment at a boundary and the null-following frame jump index read.
Exercise a callback interior view and its null last slot; null must invoke centralized incomplete failure before call.
Confirm these guards grant no strict function match and alter only the explicitly incomplete behavioral branch.
